plans.idea: Classic product-left split: the bottle fills the left 45% at full height, and the right column holds logo, headline/subheadline and CTA stacked on one shared left edge with even vertical rhythm, so the copy is large and grouped instead of scattered across empty space.

Text-led banner that reads left to right: logo, then a big Glow headline, subheadline and the button form one tight left-aligned block, and the bottle sits large on the right half as the visual payoff.

Symmetric centered poster: logo, headline and subheadline, bottle and CTA stack down one central axis, giving a calm hero composition with a clear top-to-bottom reading order across the dark gradient.
